# graylog_role (Data Source)

Retrieves a Graylog role by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_role" "example" {
  name = "Reader"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `permissions` (Set of String)
- `read_only` (Boolean)
